Definition: from G5228 and G4052; to super-abound:--abound much more, exceeding.
BiblicalUsage: hyperperisseúō is how Scripture says to abound much more, to overflow. In Romans 5:20, the text says "grace did much more abound."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hyperperisseúō means to abound much more, to overflow, and I leave it at that.
